data.name: Continue_NotOurs
data.value: This Claude Code session was started by hand: I cannot write to it. Your message stays in the thread; answer it in its terminal.

data.name: Continue_Busy
data.value: The Claude Code session of this task is still working: it reads no message before it is done. Your message stays in the thread; send it again once it has finished.

data.name: Continue_NoSession
data.value: I do not know the Claude Code session of this task: I cannot resume it. Your message stays in the thread.
